_meta.purpose: Cifra multi-instrumento de Speed of Sound (Pearl Jam, Backspacer 2009).

title: Speed of Sound
content:
{section: Intro}
[D#m] [Em] [G/B] [C] x2

{section: Verso 1}
 [D#m]             [Em]
yesterdays, how quick they change
[G/B]                      [C]
all lost and long gone now
     [D#m]             [Em]
it's hard to remember any thing
[G/B]                      [C]
moving at the speed of sound
[G/B]                        [C]
moving with the speed of sound

{section: Refrão}
            [C]     [G/B]     [G]
and yet i'm still holding tight
         [C]     [G/B]     [G]
to this dream of distant light
         [C]     [G/B]     [G]
and that somehow i'll survive
         [F]
but this night has been a long one waiting on a sun that just don't come

{section: Interlúdio}
[Em] [D] [Em] [D] [C] [D]

{section: Verso 2}
    [C]     [G/B]     [G]
can i forgive what i
[Dsus4]    [C]     [G/B]     [G]
cannot forget and live a lie?
[Dsus4]    [C]     [G/B]
i could give it one more try

{section: Verso 3}
[D#m]             [Em]
why deny this drive inside?
[G/B]                      [C]
just looking for some peace
[D#m]             [Em]
overtime i get me some
[G/B]             [C]
it gets the best of me
[G/B]                      [C]
not much left you see

{section: Refrão 2}
            [C]     [G/B]     [G]
and yet i'm still holding tight
        [C]        [G/B]     [G]
to this dream of distant light
         [C]       [G/B]     [G]
and that somehow i'll survive
[F]
but this night has been a long one waiting on a word that never comes

{section: Interlúdio}
[Em] [D] [Em] [D] [C] [D]

{section: Outro}
   [C]    [G/B]       [G]
a whisper in the dark
[Dsus4]    [C]    [G/B]       [G]
is that you or just my thoughts?
[Dsus4]    [C]    [G/B]       [G]
wide awake and reaching out

   [C]    [G/B]       [G]
it's gone so quiet now
[Dsus4]    [C]    [G/B]       [G]
could it be i'm farther out?
[Dsus4]    [C]    [G/B]       [G]
moving faster than the speed of sound
